spec.title: Interface Status
spec.description: Interface counts by admin/oper state. Oper Down > 0 warrants investigation. Admin-down interfaces are excluded by default (`monitor_admin_shut: false` in snmp-base.yaml); set to `true` to include them in counts.

spec.title: Interface Status Δ 24h
spec.description: Absolute change vs 24h ago. Zero indicates no change or data unavailable for that window.

spec.expr: count(max by(if_interface_name)(snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance",if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"} and on(device_name, ifIndex) (last_over_time(snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"}[$__range]) != 2))) - (count(max by(if_interface_name)((snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance",if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"} offset 24h) and on(device_name, ifIndex) (last_over_time(snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"}[$__range] offset 24h) != 2))) or count(max by(if_interface_name)(snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance",if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"} and on(device_name, ifIndex) (last_over_time(snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"}[$__range]) != 2))))

count(max by(if_interface_name)(snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance",if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"} and on(device_name, ifIndex) (last_over_time(snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"}[$__range]) != 2)) == 1) - (count(max by(if_interface_name)((snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance",if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"} offset 24h) and on(device_name, ifIndex) (last_over_time(snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"}[$__range] offset 24h) != 2)) == 1) or count(max by(if_interface_name)(snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance",if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"} and on(device_name, ifIndex) (last_over_time(snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"}[$__range]) != 2)) == 1))

count(max by(if_interface_name)(snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance",if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"} and on(device_name, ifIndex) (last_over_time(snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"}[$__range]) != 2)) == 2) - (count(max by(if_interface_name)((snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance",if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"} offset 24h) and on(device_name, ifIndex) (last_over_time(snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"}[$__range] offset 24h) != 2)) == 2) or count(max by(if_interface_name)(snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance",if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"} and on(device_name, ifIndex) (last_over_time(snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"}[$__range]) != 2)) == 2))

spec.title: Active Series by Metric
spec.description: Active series per metric for this device — the real breakdown of what drives its series footprint. The SNMP exporter's `module` label only appears on its own 5 self-monitoring scrape metrics, not on polled device data (interface counters, BGP, chassis, etc.), so grouping by module can't show this on this stack. To reduce series, adjust which OIDs/modules the Alloy snmp exporter component walks for this device.

spec.title: Collection Age
spec.description: Seconds since last SNMP walk (snmp_scrape_walk_duration_seconds). Green < 2m, yellow < 5m. No separate ping/identity path on the Alloy path.

spec.title: Series by Polling Tier
spec.description: Active series for this device grouped by SNMP polling tier (hot = fast poll, cold = slow poll ~8min cadence). This stack has no per-series poll_duration_sec label — snmp_tier is what determines cadence here.

spec.title: Exporter Health
spec.description: SNMP exporter target health for this device (Prometheus up). Green = UP (exporter reached and scraped it), red = DOWN. This stack has no PollingHealth reason field — see the Scrape Packet Retries table below for degraded-poll evidence.

spec.title: Total Series
spec.description: Active Prometheus series for this device right now. In Grafana Cloud, each unique metric name + label set = one billable active series. This is this device's direct contribution to your active series total.

spec.title: Exporter Health History
spec.description: History of SNMP exporter up/down transitions for this device — green=UP, red=DOWN. Gaps indicate no data collected.

spec.title: Scrape Packet Retries — Degraded Events
spec.description: Each row = a scrape where the SNMP exporter had to retry request packets for this device — a real signal of packet loss or a slow-to-respond device. This stack has no PollingHealth "reason" text, so retries are the closest degraded-poll evidence available.

spec.title: Memory Free
spec.description: Current free memory in bytes.

spec.title: Memory Total
spec.description: Total physical memory capacity (MemoryTotal).

spec.title: Error % In
spec.description:
Per-interface inbound error percentage: rate(ifInErrors) as % of rate(ifHCInUcastPkts). Use `match_attributes` in snmp-base.yaml to filter which interfaces Alloy scrapes (e.g. `if_interface_name: "^Ten.*|^Gig.*"`), reducing series at the source.

Both ifInErrors and ifHCInUcastPkts are true monotonic counters; ifInErrors is hot-tier so uses $__rate_interval; ifHCInUcastPkts is cold-tier (device updates ~every 8min) so uses a fixed 20m window instead. Clamped to 100%.

spec.expr: topk(25, max by(if_interface_name)(clamp_max(100 * sum by(device_name, if_interface_name) (if:snmp_ifInErrors:rate5m{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance", if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"}) / (rate(sum by(device_name, if_interface_name) (snmp_ifHCInUcastPkts{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance", if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"})[20m:]) + 0.001), 100)))

spec.title: Error % Out
spec.description:
Per-interface outbound error percentage: rate(ifOutErrors) as % of rate(ifHCOutUcastPkts). Use `match_attributes` in snmp-base.yaml to filter which interfaces Alloy scrapes (e.g. `if_interface_name: "^Ten.*|^Gig.*"`), reducing series at the source.

Both ifOutErrors and ifHCOutUcastPkts are true monotonic counters; ifOutErrors is hot-tier so uses $__rate_interval; ifHCOutUcastPkts is cold-tier (device updates ~every 8min) so uses a fixed 20m window instead. Clamped to 100%.

spec.expr: topk(25, max by(if_interface_name)(clamp_max(100 * sum by(device_name, if_interface_name) (if:snmp_ifOutErrors:rate5m{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance", if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"}) / (rate(sum by(device_name, if_interface_name) (snmp_ifHCOutUcastPkts{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance", if_interface_name=~"$interface_name"})[20m:]) + 0.001), 100)))

spec.title: Utilization In
spec.description: Inbound bandwidth utilization % per interface, from the if:snmp_IfInUtilization:percent recording rule (already computed as rate(ifHCInOctets)/ifHighSpeed). Collapsed by device_name/if_interface_name to dedupe snmp_group/snmp_eval_tier label churn for the same physical interface.

spec.title: Utilization Out
spec.description: Outbound bandwidth utilization % per interface, from the if:snmp_IfOutUtilization:percent recording rule (already computed as rate(ifHCOutOctets)/ifHighSpeed). Collapsed by device_name/if_interface_name to dedupe snmp_group/snmp_eval_tier label churn for the same physical interface.

spec.title: Flow Traffic over Time
spec.description: Flow data is exported by this device but may not be present in the selected time range. Widen the time range if panels appear empty.

spec.description: Bytes in active flow conversations per protocol at each point in time. Peaks represent bursts of a specific protocol. Protocol breakdown is not available from SNMP interface counters.

spec.description: Top 10 conversations by total bytes from flow records. Source: NetFlow/sFlow exported by this device.

spec.description: Conversations where src_device is this host (catalog join on the flow 5-tuple).

spec.description: Transport breakdown for flows sourced by this host.

spec.description: Top 20 dst_device / peer IPs for flows sourced by this host.

spec.description: Conversations where dst_device is this host (catalog join on the flow 5-tuple).

spec.title: To this device by Protocol

spec.description: Transport breakdown for flows destined to this host.

spec.title: Top sources
spec.description: Top 20 src_device / local IPs for flows destined to this host.

spec.title: To this device by Conversation
spec.description: Top 10 destined conversations.

spec.title: Top conversations to this device
spec.description: Top 25 destined conversations (src_device → dst_device).

spec.title: Interface IP Addresses & Flow Roles
spec.description: SNMP-discovered IP addresses (IF-MIB if_Address) that appear in flow records within the selected time range, annotated with their OTel flow role — Exporter (device_name), Local (network_local_address), or Peer (network_peer_address). IPs with no flow activity are hidden.

spec.expression: SELECT A.if_Address, A.if_AdminStatus, A.if_Description, A.if_Netmask, A.if_OperStatus, A.if_Alias, CASE WHEN B.device_name IS NOT NULL AND C.network_local_address IS NOT NULL AND D.network_peer_address IS NOT NULL THEN 'Exporter / Local / Peer' WHEN B.device_name IS NOT NULL AND C.network_local_address IS NOT NULL THEN 'Exporter / Local' WHEN B.device_name IS NOT NULL AND D.network_peer_address IS NOT NULL THEN 'Exporter / Peer' WHEN C.network_local_address IS NOT NULL AND D.network_peer_address IS NOT NULL THEN 'Local / Peer' WHEN B.device_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'Exporter' WHEN C.network_local_address IS NOT NULL THEN 'Local' WHEN D.network_peer_address IS NOT NULL THEN 'Peer' ELSE '' END AS flow_role FROM A LEFT JOIN B ON A.if_Address = B.device_name LEFT JOIN C ON A.if_Address = C.network_local_address LEFT JOIN D ON A.if_Address = D.network_peer_address WHERE A.if_Address != '__no_data__' AND (B.device_name IS NOT NULL OR C.network_local_address IS NOT NULL OR D.network_peer_address IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 200

spec.description: Per-interface status, metadata, and current traffic rate. Sorted by highest inbound. In/Out BPS are rate(ifHC*Octets) * 8 — snmp_ifHC*Octets are true monotonic counters, so rates use rate() over $__rate_interval.

When a state flip falls exactly at the edge of the time window, an interface may appear in one panel but not the other.

spec.description: Per-interface status, metadata, and current traffic rate. Sorted by highest inbound. In/Out BPS are rate(ifHC*Octets) * 8 — snmp_ifHC*Octets are true monotonic counters, so rates use rate() over $__rate_interval.

spec.title: System Info
spec.description: Alloy identity from snmp_device_info (sysName/sysDescr/sysObjectID) plus snmp_Uptime (SNMPv2 TimeTicks). job=alloy-snmp.

spec.expr: max by (device_name) (snmp_Uptime{job="alloy-snmp",snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"}) * on (device_name) group_left(sysName, sysDescr, sysObjectID, snmp_group, deployment_host) topk by (device_name) (1, snmp_device_info{job="alloy-snmp",snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance",deployment_host!=""} or snmp_device_info{job="alloy-snmp",snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$instance"})

spec.expression:
SELECT DISTINCT Field, Details FROM (
  SELECT 'Device Name' AS Field, COALESCE(sysName, device_name, 'N/A') AS Details FROM A
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sysObjectID', COALESCE(sysObjectID, 'N/A') FROM A
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Deployment host', COALESCE(deployment_host, 'N/A') FROM A
  UNION ALL SELECT 'SNMP Group', COALESCE(snmp_group, 'N/A') FROM A
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Uptime', CONCAT(FLOOR(__value__ / 8640000), 'd ', FLOOR(__value__ / 100 % 86400 / 3600), 'h ', FLOOR(__value__ / 100 % 3600 / 60), 'm') FROM A
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Description', COALESCE(sysDescr, 'N/A') FROM A
) t
LIMIT 10

spec.title: Collection Age (Last Data Point)
spec.description: Absolute timestamp of the last SNMP walk (snmp_scrape_walk_duration_seconds). No separate ping/identity path on the Alloy path — every OID including uptime comes from this same walk, so a second identity series would just duplicate this signal.

spec.title: SNMP scrape time (current)
spec.description: Last SNMP walk duration per module (if_mib / nokia_srlinux hot, if_mib_meta / ip_addr cold). Not ICMP ping RTT. job=alloy-snmp.

spec.title: SNMP scrape time
spec.description: snmp_scrape_walk_duration_seconds — one series per SNMP module. This is walk time, not ping RTT. Hot = 60s if_mib + nokia_srlinux; cold = 5m if_mib_meta + ip_addr.

spec.title: SNMP scrape retries
spec.description: snmp_scrape_packets_retried per module. Replaces ping packet loss — Alloy has no ICMP path yet.

spec.title: SNMP scrape retries (current)
spec.description: Packets retried on the last SNMP walk, per module. 0 is healthy. Not ICMP packet loss.
